replacements.instruction: Remove the redundant Table 3 row-group label 'Alternative writing systems'; the three alternative rows are already identified in the surrounding text and separated visually from Agentic CogWriter.

replacements.before: \caption{Three-run \condAgenticCogWriter\ win rates; above 50\% favors our system. Across averages run-level rates after summing benchmark wins and losses. \condNoGoals\ and \condFixedOrder\ stay near parity; \condSingleWriter\ shows a larger gap.}
replacements.after: \caption{Three-run \condAgenticCogWriter\ win rates; 50\% is parity. Across averages run-level rates from wins/losses summed across benchmarks. \condNoGoals\ and \condFixedOrder\ are near-parity ablations; \condSingleWriter\ is a bundled diagnostic with a larger gap.}
